chunks: O My creatures, there will be no fear or regret
ai.seo_question: What does God promise to the believers on the Day of Judgment regarding fear and grief?
ai.summary: This verse, frequently cited in Shia eschatological discourses, serves as the foundational promise of divine mercy that culminates in the ultimate victory of the faithful. It underscores the transition from the anxiety of worldly trials to the eternal tranquility of Jannah, a theme deeply explored by scholars like Al-Tabarsi in his tafsir as a direct counterpoint to the fear experienced by the disbelievers. The assurance of 'no fear and no grief' reflects the complete purification of the soul, aligning with the Shia understanding of the Ahl al-Bayt's role as intercessors who guide believers to this state of serenity.
